scheme.how: You apply through your council or a fostering agency. You have checks, training and an assessment before a child lives with you.

scheme.worthChecking: Your provider decides the amount and checks study place, residency, care history and benefit details.

scheme.gives: You get up to 52 weeks off work when you adopt.
